runbooks.title: Errors affecting a subset of customers
runbooks.content: Possible causes: a feature flag or experiment change, region-specific data, a partial rollout of a release, a dependency that is unhealthy in one region. Check the flag audit log and compare affected and unaffected customers.

runbooks.title: General HTTP 5xx investigation checklist
runbooks.content: 1. Find the first error in the logs and note the time. 2. Check recent deploys of the affected service near that time. 3. Check dependencies (database, payment gateway, cache). 4. Compare error rate before and after the change.

runbooks.title: Rotating the CDN signing key
runbooks.content: Steps to rotate the CDN signing key every quarter: generate a new key, publish it, wait for propagation, retire the old key.

ground_truth.root_cause: Feature flag new-pricing-engine was switched on for all traffic and routes requests through PricingEngineV2, which fails for unsupported currency JPY
culprit_references: Feature flag new-pricing-engine enabled for 100% of traffic
